questions.q_en: Which sensors does your bioreactor really have, and which ones are missing?
questions.q_zh: 你們的反應器真正有哪些感測器？哪些是沒有的？
questions.a_en: Live in the runs: in-line OD600, pH, flow and three pressure transducers at feed, retentate and permeate, plus servo control of the pinch valve and four Luer valves. Missing: dissolved oxygen, because both probes failed calibration and cannot be autoclaved. The temperature probe is fitted but not responding, so the operator types the temperature in. There is no level sensing, and green light is not integrated.
questions.a_zh: 運轉中有的：在線 OD600、pH、流量，以及進料、回流、滲透側三個壓力感測器，另有夾管閥和四個 Luer 閥的伺服控制。沒有的：溶氧，因為兩支探頭校正都撐不住、也不能高壓滅菌。溫度探頭裝了但沒有回應，所以由操作員手動輸入溫度。也沒有液位感測，綠光也還沒整合。
questions.trap_en: Listing the commercial design's sensors (temperature, four pressures) as if they were on the lab rig.
questions.trap_zh: 把商用設計的感測器（溫度、四個壓力）說成實驗台上有的。
questions.basis: like Munich 2025: what sensors and control loops exist

questions.q_en: Your pages disagree about some runs: the pH in run 2, the volume in run 1, and the first Western blot. What actually happened?
questions.q_zh: 你們的頁面對某些運轉說法不一：第 2 次的 pH、第 1 次的體積、第一張 Western blot。實際發生了什麼？
questions.a_en: On pH, the bioreactor page says integrated run 2 left the medium too acidic, while Results says pH rose; the cause was unclear and we cut the volume to 500 mL. On volume, the first September run was 500 mL on the hardware, Engineering and Results pages, but the Digital Twin table says 1 L. On the blot, the bioreactor page says a shell band is faint at best, while Results says it confirmed selective passage. These are open conflicts.
questions.a_zh: pH 方面，反應器頁說整合第 2 次運轉培養基太酸，結果頁卻說 pH 上升；原因不明，我們把體積降到 500 mL。體積方面，9 月第一次運轉在硬體、工程與結果頁都寫 500 mL，但數位孿生的表格寫 1 L。Western blot 方面，反應器頁說殼側條帶「微弱」，結果頁卻說它確認了選擇性通過。這些是尚未解決的矛盾。
questions.trap_en: Picking the more flattering version of each. State both and say which page you trust.
questions.trap_zh: 每項都選比較好看的版本。兩種都要說，並說明你信哪一頁。

questions.q_en: A valve broke at 38 hours and leaked into the incubator. What broke it, and do you actually know?
questions.q_zh: 38 小時時有一個閥斷裂、漏液到培養箱。是什麼弄壞它的？你們真的確定嗎？
kw_zh: 過氧化氫未稀釋就到閥
questions.a_en: In integrated run 3 a Luer valve at the start of the lumen loop broke in half. We blamed our clean-in-place step, because 35% peroxide reached the valve before it was diluted. Later a valve on the KOH dosing line failed too. Engineering blames KOH, but Results says peroxide and KOH go through the same fitting, so those runs cannot tell them apart. We now premix the peroxide and want alkali-resistant valves.
questions.a_zh: 整合第 3 次運轉中，管腔迴路起點的一個 Luer 閥斷成兩半。我們認為是自己的現場清潔步驟造成的，因為 35% 過氧化氫在稀釋前就流到閥。後來 KOH 加料管線上的閥也壞了。工程頁認為是 KOH，但結果頁說過氧化氫和 KOH 通過同一個接頭，這幾次運轉無法分辨。現在我們先把過氧化氫稀釋好再進系統，並打算換耐鹼的閥。
questions.trap_en: Stating one cause with certainty. Results says the two reagents cannot be separated.
questions.trap_zh: 很肯定地說只有一個原因。結果頁說兩種試劑無法區分。
questions.basis: honesty probe: what failed and how sure are you

questions.q_en: How reliable are your pressure readings? Do you have three transducers or four?
questions.q_zh: 你們的壓力讀值有多可靠？是三個還是四個壓力感測器？
kw_zh: 實驗台 3 個、規劃 4 個
questions.a_en: The rig has three, at feed, retentate and permeate. The cost list counts four and the Digital Twin shows four channels, which matches the planned commercial layout. The sensors are 1 MPa parts at 1% of full scale, about 0.1 bar, while our TMP runs a few kPa, so we read fouling as a trend, not a single value. In the 14 to 16 October run the extra pressure rose from 2.0 to 3.8 kPa; a 0 to 100 kPa sensor is the cheap upgrade.
questions.a_zh: 實驗台上有三個，分別在進料、回流、滲透側。成本表算了四個，數位孿生也顯示四個通道，這是對應規劃中的商用配置。這些感測器是 1 MPa 量程、準確度為滿量程 1%（約 0.1 bar），而我們的 TMP 只有幾 kPa，所以積垢要看趨勢，不能看單一數值。10 月 14 至 16 日那次運轉的額外壓力從 2.0 升到 3.8 kPa；換成 0 至 100 kPa 的感測器是最便宜的改善。
questions.trap_en: Saying TMP was measured precisely at 0.03 bar. The sensor's stated accuracy is larger than that.
questions.trap_zh: 說 TMP 精確量到 0.03 bar。感測器標示的準確度比這個值還大。
questions.basis: validate: instrument resolution versus the signal

questions.q_en: Is US$1022.67 really what your bioreactor costs?
questions.q_zh: US$1022.67 真的是你們反應器的成本嗎？
kw_zh: 缺控制器與 KOH 幫浦
questions.a_en: It is the known cost, not the full cost. The list leaves out the UNO Q controller, the mainboard with its converter, the KOH dosing pump and the stir bar, and the pinch valve's nuts and screws are unpriced. The photometer is US$371.78 of it and the membrane US$245. The business plan gives about US$2277 for a 1 L unit, and the bioreactor part of the prototype is NT$30 450. Those are planning estimates, not quotes.
questions.a_zh: 這是已知成本，不是完整成本。清單沒有列入 UNO Q 控制器、含轉換器的主機板、KOH 加料幫浦和攪拌子，夾管閥的螺帽螺絲也沒標價。其中光度計 US$371.78、膜 US$245。商業計畫書給 1 L 機組約 US$2277，原型中反應器部分是 NT$30 450。這些是規劃估算，不是報價。
questions.trap_en: Calling US$1022.67 the total build cost.
questions.trap_zh: 把 US$1022.67 說成完整的製作成本。
questions.basis: judge pattern: what does it cost, honestly

questions.q_en: Could this scale to a real farm? What limits it?
questions.q_zh: 這能擴大到真正的農場嗎？限制是什麼？
kw_zh: 培養基、幫浦、能源是瓶頸
questions.a_en: Our route is scale-out, copying one module, and from one to eight modules the membrane is not the limit. Medium draw, pumps and energy are: 0.96 rising to 7.7 L per day, and 3 to 8 W rising to 24 to 64 W. Those numbers assume the 2 LMH design flux; our runs drew 36 to 72 LMH. The commercial cabinet has not been built, so its output per day, power and weight are not known.
questions.a_zh: 我們的路線是複製單一模組（scale-out），從一個到八個模組時，膜不是限制。限制是培養基用量、幫浦和能源：培養基每天 0.96 增加到 7.7 L，功率從 3 至 8 W 增加到 24 至 64 W。這些數字假設設計通量 2 LMH，而我們實際運轉抽了 36 至 72 LMH。商用機櫃還沒有做出來，所以每日產量、耗電與重量都還不知道。
questions.trap_en: Saying the system scales because the membrane never limits. Medium, pumps and power do.
questions.trap_zh: 說因為膜不是限制所以能擴大。培養基、幫浦和電力才是。

questions.q_en: What is the next step before a farmer could actually use it?
questions.q_zh: 在農民真正能使用之前，下一步是什麼？
questions.a_en: The farmer cabinet, about 400 by 240 by 620 mm with a 7-inch screen and sealed refill cartridges, is a design; it has not been built. The planning price is about US$2277 for a 1 L unit. Before any sale the wiki says we would pilot five to ten units for one growing season to measure operating cost, reliability and field performance. The cartridges still need a reliable seal, because the printed parts were not watertight.
questions.a_zh: 給農民用的機櫃約 400 × 240 × 620 mm，配 7 吋螢幕和密封補充卡匣，目前只是設計，還沒有做出來。規劃價格約 US$2277（1 L 機組）。wiki 寫明在任何銷售之前，會先試點五到十台、跑一個種植季，量測營運成本、可靠度與田間表現。卡匣還需要可靠的密封，因為列印零件不防水。
questions.trap_en: Describing the commercial cabinet as built or tested.
questions.trap_zh: 把商用機櫃說成已做好或測過。
questions.basis: judge pattern: what is the next step and what is the evidence it can work

questions.q_en: Would your system work for a different or larger protein, or another organism?
questions.q_zh: 你們的系統能用在別種或更大的蛋白質，或別的生物上嗎？
questions.a_en: Only ACC deaminase was followed for 72 hours. In one run LEA14 and BoPep4 also read the same on both sides, 5.8 against 5.9 and 6.2 against 5.4 µg/mL. The membrane sorts by size and the roughly 36 kDa enzyme crosses, so a much larger protein or aggregate is untested. The hardware is the same for strain 168 or WB800, but 168 barely made enzyme. No other chassis was tried.
questions.a_zh: 只有 ACC deaminase 追蹤了 72 小時。在一次運轉中，LEA14 和 BoPep4 兩側的數值也相近，分別是 5.8 對 5.9、6.2 對 5.4 µg/mL。膜依大小篩選，約 36 kDa 的酵素能通過，所以更大的蛋白質或聚集物還沒有測過。硬體對 168 或 WB800 都一樣，但 168 幾乎沒產出酵素。我們沒有試過其他底盤。
questions.trap_en: Saying any protein will cross. Only three were read, in one run.
questions.trap_zh: 說任何蛋白質都能通過。只在一次運轉中讀過三種。
questions.basis: boundary probe: can it apply to something else

questions.q_en: What is the upper limit of your photometer, and what happens in a denser culture?
questions.q_zh: 你們光度計的上限是多少？培養液更濃時會怎樣？
questions.a_en: On silica the Pro reads about 1:1 with the BioDrop up to about OD 2.5, then reads low. In the 14 October run the sample beam fell to a tenth of the reference above about OD 2.7 and the gate marked it low signal; the 77-hour run read to 3.34. Above that, samples would be drawn by hand. The Slim may reach about five times further, but that is an estimate, untested past the top of the series.
questions.a_zh: 在矽球上，Pro 與 BioDrop 約 1:1，到約 OD 2.5 為止，之後讀值偏低。10 月 14 日那次運轉在約 OD 2.7 以上樣品光束掉到參考的十分之一，閘門把它標為訊號過低；77 小時那次讀到 3.34。再高就得手動抽樣。Slim 可能能多量約五倍，但那只是估計，沒有測過超出矽球系列上限的範圍。
questions.trap_en: Quoting one limit. The wiki gives about 2.5, 2.7 and 3.34 in different places.
questions.trap_zh: 只報一個上限。wiki 在不同地方寫約 2.5、2.7、3.34。
questions.basis: boundary probe: limits of the instrument

questions.q_en: How do your hardware sensors feed the digital twin?
questions.q_zh: 你們的硬體感測器怎麼餵給數位孿生？
questions.a_en: Pressure, flow, OD and pH go to the Digital Twin. Wall shear from the pressure sensors and from the flowmeter agree to 2.8%, so each checks the other. An autoencoder on the photometer's reference beam flagged the failing sensor 26.7 hours before OD became unusable. A Kalman filter cut two-hour forecast error by 41% on the September run but 0% on the last run, and 24% at 8 and 12 hours. So far the models run on recorded data and a person decides.
questions.a_zh: 壓力、流量、OD、pH 都送進數位孿生。由壓力感測器和由流量計算出的管壁剪切率相差 2.8%，兩者互相檢查。對光度計參考光束做的自編碼器，在 OD 無法使用前 26.7 小時就標出感測器故障。Kalman 濾波在 9 月那次運轉讓兩小時預測誤差降低 41%，在最後一次運轉是 0%，8 與 12 小時則降低 24%。目前模型都在記錄好的資料上跑，決定仍由人做。
questions.trap_en: Saying the twin controls the reactor automatically. A person approves every decision.
questions.trap_zh: 說數位孿生會自動控制反應器。每項決定都由人核可。
questions.basis: integrate: hardware to model, like Munich 2025

questions.q_en: Why a peristaltic pump, and which pump model do you actually use?
questions.q_zh: 為什麼用蠕動幫浦？你們實際用的是哪一型？
kw_en: magnetic pump could not push medium
kw_zh: 磁力幫浦推不動培養基
questions.a_en: A peristaltic tube wears in long runs, so we tested a magnetic pump. With culture medium it could not build pressure, could not lift liquid from the bottle and never held a working flow, so the peristaltic stayed. One loose end: the cost list names a BP1000 rated 1 L/min, our calibration reached 1535 mL/min, and other pages cite a ZP4000 rated 230 to 2600 mL/min. I cannot reconcile the model name from the wiki.
questions.a_zh: 蠕動幫浦的管子在長時間運轉會磨損，所以我們試了磁力幫浦。用培養基時它建不起壓力、無法從瓶中抽液，也始終沒有穩定流量，所以還是留用蠕動幫浦。有一個沒解決的地方：成本表寫的是額定 1 L/min 的 BP1000，我們校正時卻到 1535 mL/min，其他頁面則引用額定 230 至 2600 mL/min 的 ZP4000。型號名稱我無法從 wiki 對上。
questions.trap_en: Claiming the peristaltic pump is the better pump. It wears out sooner; it was the only one that worked.
questions.trap_zh: 說蠕動幫浦比較好。它磨損較快，只是唯一能用的。
questions.basis: design check plus an unreconciled specification

questions.q_en: How do you sterilize the loop, and how do you handle the waste?
questions.q_zh: 你們怎麼滅菌循環管路？廢棄物怎麼處理？
kw_zh: 900 mL 水＋100 mL 過氧化氫
questions.a_en: We cannot autoclave the assembled loop, so we clean in place: 900 mL water and 100 mL of 35% hydrogen peroxide circulate for 15 minutes, starch–iodide paper checks for peroxide, then about five 1 L rinses. Waste is separate: solid waste is autoclaved at 121 °C for 15 to 30 minutes and liquids are bleached, at BSL-1. The price was a broken valve when peroxide reached it undiluted, so the mixing step changed.
questions.a_zh: 組裝好的循環放不進高壓滅菌鍋，所以我們現場清潔：900 mL 水加 100 mL 35% 過氧化氫循環 15 分鐘，用澱粉碘化物試紙檢查過氧化氫，再沖洗約五次 1 L 的水。廢棄物另外處理：在 BSL-1 下，固態廢棄物以 121 °C 高壓滅菌 15 至 30 分鐘，液體用漂白水處理。代價是過氧化氫未稀釋就流到閥，閥因此斷裂，所以後來改了混合步驟。
questions.trap_en: Saying the loop is autoclaved. It is chemically cleaned; only waste is autoclaved.
questions.trap_zh: 說循環管路有高壓滅菌。它是化學清潔，只有廢棄物高壓滅菌。
questions.basis: judge pattern: safety and sterility of the device
